INDIAN SCHOOLS

<!-- page 557 -->
PROGRAMME OF STUDIES FOR INDIAN SCHOOLS

THE Programme of studies herein prescribed shall be followed by the teacher as far as the circumstances of his
school permit. Any modifications deemed necessary shall be made only with the concurrence of the department.
